question:
In given figure AH ∥ BG ∥ CF, ∠DCF = 55°. Find the value of ∠AED ∶ ∠BDE.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d837bbbe76e36c792634a9eb293219f44a764670ad4d1278e49dc8dcba3aa36e.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the lines AH, BG, and CF are parallel, the transversal line intersecting them creates corresponding angles.

Given ∠DCF = 55°, by alternate and corresponding angle properties, ∠AED = ∠DCF = 55°.

Since AH || BG, ∠AED and ∠BDE form a pair of consecutive interior angles.

The sum of consecutive interior angles is 180°, so ∠BDE = 180° − 55° = 125°.

Ratio of ∠AED to ∠BDE = 55 ÷ 125 = 11 : 25.

**∴ The correct answer is 11 : 25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ AH || BG || CF

⇒ ∠DCF = 55°

**Concept Used:**

⇒ Alternate Angles: Angles on opposite sides of a transversal between parallel lines are equal.

⇒ Consecutive Interior Angles: Angles on the same side of a transversal between parallel lines add up to 180°.
